name: C2 F1/F2 statement-fidelity probe set (hand-built, NOT a random sample)
scope: Didactic probe set for the fidelity gate of the audit protocol. Each case is a pair (intent statement, formalised statement). Ground-truth labels were assigned by the author; the checker never sees them.
checker_ceiling_disclosure: The checker uses a fixed 24-term condition vocabulary + numeral set + strict-inequality count + quantifier class. Drift outside this vocabulary, or drift that leaves all extracted features identical (e.g. a converse/direction swap), is invisible to it by construction.

cases.intent: For every nonzero real x, the map f(x)=1/x satisfies f(f(x))=x.
cases.formal: For every real x, the map f(x)=1/x satisfies f(f(x))=x.

cases.intent: For every continuous function f on [0,1] with f(0)=f(1), f attains a maximum.
cases.formal: For every function f on [0,1] with f(0)=f(1), f attains a maximum.

cases.intent: For every odd integer n greater than 1, the square of n leaves remainder 1 on division by 8.
cases.formal: For every integer n greater than 1, the square of n leaves remainder 1 on division by 8.

cases.intent: Every nonempty finite subset of the integers has a least element.
cases.formal: Every finite subset of the integers has a least element.

cases.intent: For every integer n at least 3, the sum of the first n positive integers is even.
cases.formal: For every integer n at least 2, the sum of the first n positive integers is even.

cases.intent: For every prime p at least 5, p squared minus 1 is divisible by 24.
cases.formal: For every prime p at least 3, p squared minus 1 is divisible by 24.

cases.intent: For every integer n at least 100, the interval from 0 to n contains at least 25 primes.
cases.formal: For every integer n at least 10, the interval from 0 to n contains at least 25 primes.

cases.intent: For every real x with x < 1, the series with terms x^n converges.
cases.formal: For every real x with x <= 1, the series with terms x^n converges.

cases.intent: For every real x with 0 < x < 1, the square of x is less than x.
cases.formal: For every real x with 0 <= x <= 1, the square of x is at most x.

cases.intent: For every integer n with 1 <= n < 10, n divides 2^n minus 2.
cases.formal: For every integer n with 1 <= n <= 10, n divides 2^n minus 2.

cases.intent: There exists a real root of the equation x squared plus 1 equal to zero.
cases.formal: For every real x, x squared plus 1 is nonzero.

cases.intent: For every positive epsilon there exists a positive delta with |f(x)-f(a)| < epsilon.
cases.formal: For every positive epsilon and for every positive delta, |f(x)-f(a)| < epsilon.

cases.intent: Every compact subset of the real line is bounded.
cases.formal: There exists a compact subset of the real line that is bounded.

cases.intent: Every convergent sequence of real numbers is bounded.
cases.formal: There exists a bounded sequence of real numbers that is convergent.

cases.intent: Every differentiable function on the real line is continuous.
cases.formal: Every continuous function on the real line is differentiable.

cases.intent: Every bounded sequence of real numbers has a convergent subsequence.
cases.formal: Every sequence of real numbers that has a convergent subsequence is bounded.

cases.intent: For every integer n, n is even if and only if the square of n is even.
cases.formal: For every integer n, n is even if and only if the square of n is even.

cases.intent: For every positive real x, the logarithm of x is defined.
cases.formal: For every real x that is positive, the logarithm of x is defined.

cases.intent: Every compact subset of the plane is bounded.
cases.formal: Every compact subset of the plane is bounded.

cases.intent: Every continuous function on the closed unit interval has an integral that exists.
cases.formal: For every continuous function on the closed unit interval, the integral exists.

cases.intent: For every integer n at least 2, n factorial is divisible by n.
cases.formal: For every integer n at least 2, n factorial is divisible by n.

cases.intent: Every finite set S has a power set whose cardinality is 2 raised to the cardinality of S.
cases.formal: For every finite set S, the cardinality of the power set of S is 2 raised to the cardinality of S.
